regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 37", 25" of it Thursday. Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. Winter Storm Warning at Kirkwood from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Brighton is forecast for about 33". Snowbasin and Powder Mountain follow. Winter Storm Warning at Brighton from Thursday to Saturday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 24", 20" of it Thursday. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 27". Jackson Hole and Sun Valley follow. The NWS is calling for more at Jackson Hole: 10 to 25 inches Thursday through Monday. Winter Weather Advisory at Grand Targhee from Thursday night to Friday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 25", 14" of it Tuesday. Whistler follows. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whistler Tuesday.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 16", 11" of it Tuesday. Mt. Bachelor and Stevens Pass follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Aspen Highlands is forecast for about 8". Telluride and Steamboat follow.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 11". Taos follows.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
